identity.description: Datadog observability and security SaaS platform. Public REST API documented at docs.datadoghq.com/api for programmatic access to the platform.
identity.identity_notes: Product is Datadog's observability platform, as described on its public API docs. Official Python client is in the DataDog GitHub org. Datadog Labs plugin repos are plugins, not the server.

auth.oauth_flows: OAuth 2.0 is documented for MCP client connection to the Datadog MCP Server and is recommended for most users. REST API auth page does not mention OAuth2.
auth.scopes_notes: REST API uses API key (DD-API-KEY) for writes and Application key (DD-APPLICATION-KEY) for reads. MCP server also needs mcp_read/mcp_write permissions.

access.production_restrictions: MCP Server in Preview for some toolsets/clients; org must enable MCP Access; US1-FED and US2-FED not supported.

api.rate_limits: Per-endpoint buckets; exceeding returns HTTP 429; headers X-RateLimit-Limit, -Remaining, -Period, -Reset, -Name.
api.limitations: Rate limits vary per endpoint; event submission limit is per organization. Plan/tier for API access not established.
